SHIONTHEBRUISER-DAMAGE_CAP.title: Damage Cap
SHIONTHEBRUISER-DAMAGE_CAP.description: Each hit of this Attack can only deal up to [blue]{DamageCap}[/blue] damage.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-CRITICAL_HIT.title: Critical
SHIONTHEBRUISER-CRITICAL_HIT.description:
[gold]Critical Hits[/gold] deal [blue]50%[/blue] more damage.
Cards, Powers and relics can increase your [gold]Critical Hit[/gold] chance, rolled for each hit.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-CRITICAL_DRAW.title: Critical Draw
SHIONTHEBRUISER-CRITICAL_DRAW.descriptio:
When you draw this card from your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold], gain [blue]{CriticalDraw}%[/blue] [gold]Critical Hit[/gold] chance this turn.
[gold]Critical Draw[/gold] can grant at most [blue]50%[/blue] [gold]Critical Hit[/gold] chance per turn.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-PATCH_UP.title: Patch Up
SHIONTHEBRUISER-PATCH_UP.description:
Heal for {PatchUp:cond:>0?[blue]{PatchUp}[/blue] HP|the amount specified}.
This healing cannot put you above [blue]50%[/blue] of your Max HP, unless modified by other effects.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-TEAM_BLAST_GAUGE.title: Team Blast
SHIONTHEBRUISER-TEAM_BLAST_GAUGE.descrip:
Players fill this gauge together by dealing damage, blocking damage and taking damage. Whenever any creature dies, fill it by [blue]{DeathBonus}[/blue] ([blue]{OstyDeathBonus}[/blue] for an ally [gold]Osty[/gold]).
Once full, players with a [gold]Team Blast[/gold] card add an [gold]Ethereal[/gold] copy of it into their [gold]Hand[/gold] at the start of each turn.
Only one [gold]Team Blast[/gold] can be used per combat. The gauge carries over between combats, but empties after a combat where a [gold]Team Blast[/gold] was used.
